input.overview: Cherry Bell is a bonus-building game with different multipliers for two collections. The top-center lane lights 2x at the upper-right Collect Bonus saucer, while one of the three center saucers awards 3x for end-of-ball bonus. Build the base bonus to 100,000 through the left orbit and bonus-advance switches, then choose whether to collect now and rebuild or preserve the larger end-of-ball payout.
input.simpleOverview: Plunge or shoot the left orbit for the top-center lane to light 2x at the Collect Bonus saucer. Shoot the three center saucers until one awards 3x for end-of-ball bonus. Build the base bonus, then collect it at the upper-right saucer only when taking the points now is worth resetting the base bonus to 10,000.
input.summary: Light the collect doubler through the top-center lane, then use the center saucers to find the end-of-ball tripler. Keep sending the ball up the left orbit to build bonus; collect only when you can afford to reset that bonus and rebuild it.

quickInfo.name: Light 3x End-of-Ball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the three center saucers until they award it.

quickInfo.name: Advance Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Use the left orbit, top-right lane, star rollovers, left return lane, or outer-right outlane.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the upper-right saucer; the base bonus then resets to 10,000.

steps.text: Plunge through the top-center lane; if you miss it, shoot the left orbit until that lane lights 2x at the Collect Bonus saucer.
Shoot the three center saucers until one awards 3x for end-of-ball bonus; their kickouts normally return the ball safely.
Repeat the left orbit to add base bonus and return the ball to the top lanes.
When the base bonus is high, choose between preserving the tripled end-of-ball payout and shooting the upper-right saucer to collect up to 2x now, reset the base to 10,000, and rebuild.

alternatives.title: Preserve the tripled bonus
alternatives.when: Use this when the current end-of-ball bonus is enough for the score you need.

steps.text: Avoid the upper-right Collect Bonus saucer so the base bonus does not reset.
Keep using controlled left-orbit shots to add bonus without targeting the rebound-heavy standups.
Let the ball drain without tilting to receive the 3x end-of-ball bonus.
Build the base bonus toward 100,000 with the left orbit and bonus-advance switches.
Shoot the upper-right saucer to collect the current base bonus at up to 2x.
After the base resets to 10,000, return to the left orbit and rebuild before the ball ends.

machineSetup: Test the top-center and top-right lanes, left orbit, all three center saucers and kickouts, Collect Bonus saucer, bonus ladder, multiplier lamps, and right-side post.
Confirm five-ball play, Special and Extra Ball conversion, saucer award order, maximum base bonus, and whether each saucer feed can be brought under control.

playfieldReferences.label: Top-center 2x lane
playfieldReferences.description: Top lane that lights 2x for the Collect Bonus saucer.

playfieldReferences.label: Left orbit
playfieldReferences.description: Repeatable shot to the top lanes that also advances base bonus.

playfieldReferences.label: Three center saucers
playfieldReferences.description: Center cove that cycles awards including 3x end-of-ball bonus and the right-side post.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper-right Collect Bonus saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Hole that collects the base bonus at up to 2x and resets it to 10,000.

playfieldReferences.label: Right-side post
playfieldReferences.description: Raised post that can block some balls from the right outlane.

cautions.issue: The 2x and 3x multipliers apply to different bonus collections.
cautions.response: Use 2x only at the Collect Bonus saucer; preserve 3x for end-of-ball bonus and remember that collecting resets the base bonus to 10,000.

cautions.issue: The raised right-side post does not stop every right-outlane drain.
cautions.response: Treat the post as partial protection and keep nudging early when the ball heads toward the right-side lanes.
